# Learn Claude

> A beginner-first educational guide to using Claude across chat, uploads, Research, Projects, Artifacts, Design, Cowork, Code, Office, Chrome, connectors, skills, plugins, and model fit. Independent site — not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic. Verify product claims against the official sources linked in the Sources section.

Data boundary: educational examples only. Do not paste PHI, patient or learner identifiers, credentials, or confidential/restricted data into prompts or exported prompt packs.

## Sections

- [Start and task picker](https://rkalani1.github.io/claude/#start): pick a task and copy a ready-to-use prompt
- [Set up once](https://rkalani1.github.io/claude/#setup): account, personal instructions, memory, connectors, first Project
- [Prompt Lab](https://rkalani1.github.io/claude/#prompt-lab): turn a rough request into a structured prompt with model-fit guidance
- [Surfaces](https://rkalani1.github.io/claude/#surfaces): which Claude surface fits which task, with official setup links
- [Fix an answer](https://rkalani1.github.io/claude/#fix-answer): recovery prompts for weak answers and a verify-before-relying rubric
- [Agentic workflows](https://rkalani1.github.io/claude/#agents): safe, human-approved workflow design from Projects to the Agent SDK
- [Updates](https://rkalani1.github.io/claude/#features): dated feature notes reviewed against official Claude and Anthropic sources
- [Sources](https://rkalani1.github.io/claude/#sources): official courses and documentation links
